name: mathify-mobile-shell
description: Capacitor shell that serves the reviewed Mathify web app on Android and iOS.

scripts.add:android: node scripts/prepare-native.js && node scripts/configure.js --platform android && cap add android && node scripts/prepare-native.js && node scripts/native-permissions.js
scripts.add:ios: node scripts/prepare-native.js && node scripts/configure.js --platform ios && cap add ios && node scripts/prepare-native.js && node scripts/native-permissions.js
scripts.sync: node scripts/prepare-native.js && node scripts/configure.js && cap sync && node scripts/native-permissions.js
